principle: Resource flows stay separate by accounting concept. Unknown is explicit; withdrawal is not consumption, wastewater is not complete return flow, and derived annual balances are not metered grid flows.

tornio_2024.label: Outokumpu Tornio site
tornio_2024.boundary: integrated Tornio production site; environmental-report boundary

hamina_2024.label: Google Hamina campus
hamina_2024.boundary: Hamina campus; Google operational water reporting excludes seawater

discharge.note: Nebius does not report 2025 discharge with sufficient coverage.

consumption.note: Nebius does not report 2025 water consumption with sufficient coverage.
Withdrawal minus wastewater flow is not labelled net consumption.
P3+P7 discharge exceeds raw-water withdrawal, so subtraction is not a valid consumptive-use calculation; accounting includes additional water pathways.

seawater_cooling_withdrawal.note: YVA confirms seawater intake for cooling and states actual withdrawals have remained below the permit ceiling, but the currently available public source does not give the actual annual volume.

seawater_return.note: Cooling seawater is returned to the sea, but an actual annual return volume is not available in the current public audit data.

total_consumption.note: Google's reported operational water metrics exclude seawater; no total campus consumptive-use balance is inferred.

measured_grid_import.note: Environmental report provides site electricity use, not the gross grid-import boundary used by the grid-dependence metric.

water_withdrawal_multiple.interpretation: Kemi 2025 reported withdrawal divided by Nebius Finland-1 2025 reported withdrawal. Same accounting concept and year; different industrial processes. Descriptive scale difference, not an overall environmental ranking.

tornio_nebius_water_withdrawal_multiple.interpretation: Tornio 2024 raw-water withdrawal divided by Nebius Finland-1 2025 reported withdrawal. Different years and industrial processes; descriptive scale signal only.

kemi_tornio_water_withdrawal_multiple.interpretation: Kemi 2025 water withdrawal divided by Tornio 2024 raw-water withdrawal. Similar order of magnitude; source composition differs.

tornio_nebius_electricity_multiple.interpretation: Observed Tornio 2024 electricity use divided by derived Nebius 2025 electricity use.

kemi_hamina_total_water_comparison.reason: Kemi observation is total reported mill withdrawal, while Hamina observation excludes seawater and the actual cooling-seawater withdrawal is unknown. A numeric ratio would compare different water scopes.

tornio_hamina_total_water_comparison.reason: Tornio raw-water withdrawal includes seawater and river water; Hamina reported operational withdrawal excludes seawater. Actual Hamina seawater throughput is unknown.

kemi_nebius_external_useful_heat_multipl.interpretation: Kemi district-heating operator's 2025 purchased heat from Metsä Fibre divided by Nebius Finland-1's 2025 reported heat export. Descriptive transfer-volume comparison, not efficiency.

hamina_external_useful_heat_actual_compa.reason: Hamina currently has a 40 GWh/y design potential and evidence that operation began at the end of 2025, but no comparable full-year measured external heat delivery in the audit data.

tornio_external_useful_heat_comparison.reason: Tornio's 98 GWh figure is site heat recovery, not established as external useful-heat export; it is a different accounting role from Nebius and Kemi district-heat transfers.

district_heat_transfer.role: external useful heat purchased by district-heating operator

actual_district_heat_delivery.note: Heat-recovery use began at the end of 2025; no full-year measured delivery figure is in the current audit data.

recovered_heat.role: site heat recovery; not established as external heat export
